description: This Java class 'EmailService' provides core email mailbox operations such as listing, searching, composing, sending, and updating email messages within an application. It manages email entities and interactions with user accounts using Spring framework annotations and patterns.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Service class handling email mailbox operations like listing, searching, composing, sending, and updating emails, integrating with repositories for data persistence.

methods.name: listInbox
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of emails in the inbox folder for the specified user.

methods.name: listSent
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of sent emails for the user.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of draft emails for the user.

methods.name: listTrash
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of trashed emails for the user.

methods.name: listArchived
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of archived emails for the user.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across emails' subject and body for the user based on a query string.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific email, if owned by the user.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Creates and saves a draft email for the user.

methods.name: composeAndSend
methods.description: Composes an email, sends it, and internally delivers copies to recipients if they are registered users.

methods.name: deliverToRecipients
methods.description: Internal helper to deliver email copies to recipient users synchronously within the database.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates flags such as read, starred, archived, and deleted status for an email owned by the user.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Utility method to trim and sanitize string inputs.

methods.name: toListItem
methods.description: Converts an Email entity to an EmailListItem DTO, preparing a preview snippet.

methods.name: toDetail
methods.description: Converts an Email entity to an EmailDetail DTO with full email information.
